# SYNMANITAI Founding Essay

> Founding essay on collaborative thinking between humans and language models — a descriptive, methodological grammar. Part of the open Manitai universe.

## About

This page is part of the **Augmanitai Research Programme** by **Andreas Ehstand** — Independent Researcher, Human-AI Interaction. Descriptive phenomenology of patterns observed when humans think together with AI language models. Provider-independent, bilingual (EN/DE), published in the commons.
